sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fall Ailment is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 5 Disposable syringes in raid
- Hand over the items

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
- 2× Pile of meds
"Were you able to find them? Excellent, I'll begin administering the vaccines tomorrow."
